title: Technician Stocking Of Automated Dispensing Devices
subtopic: Technician stocking of automated dispensing devices
rule_summary: Massachusetts Policy 2023-08 creates credential-specific ADD inventory pathways: trainees may handle pharmacist-verified Schedule III-VI stock; licensed non-trainee technicians may handle pharmacist-verified Schedule II-VI stock; a nationally certified licensed technician has a narrow no-prior-verification pathway for sealed non-patient-specific non-PMP Schedule VI stock with electronic validation.
exam_relevance: Tests a distinct pharmacist decision path using current official authority rather than rote trivia.
verification_notes: Authoring-session current official-source verification on 2026-08-14; requires fresh independent audit before release.
